example_zh: 這份報告用 equable 來說明正式語境中該議題的重要部分。

near_synonyms.difference: aspect is broader and more general; equable is used as a more specific vocabulary item.
factor emphasizes influence in a system, while equable follows its own lexical meaning and usage pattern.

usage_note: equable is intended for college-level vocabulary study; review the collocations before using it in writing.
